headline: Prajay Engineers Syndicate appoints new auditing firms from April 2026
hook: Auditor changes take effect next fiscal
summary: Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited has announced the appointment of M/s. R B Associates and M/s. G P Reddy & Associates in an auditor or similar capacity effective April 1, 2026. The filing was submitted to the stock exchanges as a routine corporate disclosure. Such appointments are standard administrative procedures for listed companies to ensure compliance. For retail investors, this procedural filing has no immediate bearing on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no immediate financial impact

headline: Prajay Engineers Syndicate reports voting outcomes from annual general meeting
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2025, to the stock exchanges. This procedural filing completes the post-meeting compliance requirements for the company. Retail shareholders can review the approved resolutions and voting patterns on the exchange portals. For an ordinary investor holding the stock, this routine disclosure carries no immediate financial or fundamental impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
